headline: Colombia Central Bank to Purchase $2 Billion Directly from Government Treasury
summary: Banco de la República will purchase US$2 billion directly from the National Treasury before the end of 2026, executed at the prevailing exchange rate on the transaction date.
why: Direct foreign exchange transactions between a central bank and the national treasury alter international reserves and influence domestic currency liquidity dynamics.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Large central bank FX purchases from the treasury directly impact domestic monetary base and foreign reserves.
